_comment: Verified sample packs — the ONLY legal `deps` values for stems. samples: exact snippet to send via /strudel/send (plain eval) before dependent tracks; wait load_seconds. preloaded packs are loaded by livecode.html at init (no send needed, deps entry still legal).

tidal-drum-machines.notes: Use via .bank(). Verified banks: RolandTR808, RolandTR909, RolandTR707, RolandTR505, AkaiLinn, RhythmAce, ViscoSpaceDrum, RolandCompurhythm1000, CasioRZ1.

uzu-drumkit.notes: Bare drum names (no .bank()): bd sd hh oh cp cr rd rim sh tb cb lt mt ht, plus brk (breakbeat) and misc.

vcsl.notes: 128 orchestral/mallet/percussion instruments. Mallets are quiet (vibraphone rms .05 @ gain .7) — budget gains up. Highlights: vibraphone(_soft/_bowed), marimba, kalimba..kalimba5, balafon, glockenspiel, xylophone_*, tubularbells, timpani, folkharp, harp, psaltery_pluck, dantranh, didgeridoo, recorders, sax, harmonica, organ_full, pipeorgan_*, steinway, kawai, fmpiano, clavisynth, gong, framedrum, darbuka, bongo, conga, cajon, agogo, guiro, clave, woodblock, oceandrum, wineglass.

wavetables.notes: 65 AKWF wavetables, all wt_* prefixed: wt_01..wt_20, wt_flute, wt_epiano, wt_cello, wt_violin, wt_clarinett, wt_oboe, wt_altosax, wt_theremin, wt_vgame, wt_vgamebasic, wt_oscchip, wt_ebass, wt_dbass, wt_aguitar, wt_eguitar, wt_eorgan, wt_clavinet, wt_piano, wt_fmsynth, wt_granular, wt_hvoice, wt_hdrawn, wt_overtone, wt_sinharm, wt_stringbox, wt_distorted, wt_bitreduced, wt_birds, wt_snippets, wt_pluckalgo, wt_raw, wt_linear, wt_symetric, wt_c604, wt_bw_blended, wt_bw_perfectwaves, wt_bw_saw, wt_bw_sawbright, wt_bw_sawgap, wt_bw_sawrounded, wt_bw_sin, wt_bw_squ, wt_bw_squrounded, wt_bw_tri, wt_stereo.

Breaks are named: amen, think, apache, funkydrummer, king, sport, kool, around, riffin, neworleans, hitormiss, action, hotline, swat, ripple, fireeater, hungup, newday, movement, boogiewoogie, delight, eeloil, impeach, marymary, sneakin, squib, groove, useme, sesame, do, rill, mechanicalman. dirt-samples.notes: Classic Dirt pack. Verified: amencutup (n 0..). Huge misc pool (east, breath, etc.) — verify any specific name you depend on before authoring against it.

EmuSP12.notes: E-mu SP-12 lo-fi drums. Use via .bank("EmuSP12"). Verified bd/sd/hh. Boom-bap / lo-fi hip-hop character.

mridangam.notes: SINGLE-ARG load only (manifest carries its own _base; passing a base URL breaks it). Sounds: mridangam_tha, mridangam_dhin, mridangam_ki, mridangam_thom, mridangam_ta, mridangam_nam, mridangam_na, mridangam_dhi, mridangam_dhum, mridangam_ka, mridangam_gumki, mridangam_chaapu, mridangam_ardha. Indian carnatic percussion.
